answer: Proof of Burn provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Like a shifting dune of capital, the cost to spoof identities scales linearly with value incineration. An attacker attempting to ripple fake nodes across the network faces a steep economic knoll, as the capital commitment required to eclipse honest agents grows prohibitively expensive, ensuring that identity scarcity remains tied to provable financial skin in the game.
